title: Warm Springy Ethiopian Pilchards Ye Beg Alicha
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish featuring pilchards, long-fermentation-dough, and a blend of spices, served in a lacquerware bowl. This shojin-friendly recipe is perfect for a spring brunch.
instructions: In a large lacquerware bowl, combine the flaked pilchards, chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger.
In a small bowl, mix together the berbere spice, turmeric, salt, and black pepper.
Add the spice mixture to the pilchard mixture and stir well.
Heat the vegetable oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add the long-fermentation-dough to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until lightly browned.
Break the cooked dough into small pieces and add to the pilchard mixture.
Stir well to combine and serve warm.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Serve in the lacquerware bowl and enjoy.
